title: feat(state): select the shared-state database engine from config

commit.messageHeadline: feat(state): select the shared-state database engine from config
fix(state): repair bootstrap build and config baseline
fix(state): repair PostgreSQL startup and CI checks
fix(postgres): report bridge connection failures promptly
fix(gateway): preserve caller context when closing database runtime
refactor(state): install the database engine selection once at boot
fix(gateway): settle startup config and preserve no-op publications
test(gateway): align config publication and reload fixtures
fix(infra): preserve preflight snapshots for async identity reads
chore: merge main and retain both PostgreSQL conformance targets
test(state): align inherited worker probes after read cutover
fix(gateway): fence equal-config reloads by secrets activation
chore: integrate main for R1 compatibility
test(gateway): keep companion context fixture in one state scope
fix(config): preserve publication after in-place edits
